Our Why

Why we started
Dessert Atlas

Reason 01
A Love for Sweets
It all started with one simple truth — we are absolutely, completely, helplessly obsessed with desserts. From the first bite of a warm gulab jamun to discovering a flaky French croissant, sweets have always made everything better. We didn't just want to eat them — we wanted to understand them, recreate them, and give every classic a little Indian soul. A pinch of cardamom here, a dash of rose water there — and suddenly the whole world tastes like home.
Reason 02
Baby Entrepreneurs
We're 10 and we already know — we want to build something of our own. Dessert Atlas isn't just a sweet hobby, it's our first ever business! We're learning how to think like entrepreneurs — what people love, how to present it beautifully, and how to make something people keep coming back for. And honestly? What better first business than one built on desserts with an Indian twist that nobody else is doing.
Reason 03
Best Friends, Big Dreams
Every great adventure is better with your best friend. Ajitha and Prathyangi have been inseparable — and starting Dessert Atlas together just made sense. We laugh in the kitchen, argue about flavours (lovingly), and push each other to do better every single time. This isn't just a business. It's a best friendship poured into every dessert — with a generous helping of Indian spice on top.
What We're Doing

Exploring world desserts — one Indian twist at a time

We're on a delicious mission to try iconic desserts from France, Germany, Italy, America, India and beyond — and reimagine each one with bold Indian flavours. Think saffron panna cotta, masala chai tiramisu, and cardamom black forest cake. We're testing recipes, sharing with family and friends, and building Dessert Atlas into something truly special — one bite at a time.

Our Story

Made with love,
shared with the world

We're two 10-year-old best friends with one big dream — to taste and share the most amazing desserts from every corner of the world. This is just the beginning!

Co-founder · The Twist Maker
Ajitha
Ajitha lives to explore desserts from every corner of the world — but she never makes them boring. Her brain works like this: "What if tiramisu… but make it masala chai?" And somehow, it's the best thing you've ever tasted. She roams the globe (through cookbooks and YouTube) hunting for classics, then flips them on their head with a bold Indian twist — think cardamom, saffron, rose water, and a little bit of magic — in the most delicious way possible.
Co-founder · The Problem Solver
Prathyangi
Cake too dry? Mousse not fluffy enough? Call Prathyangi. While everyone else is busy eating the dessert, she's already figuring out what could make it better. She's the kind of person who reads a recipe, spots the mistake before even trying it, and comes up with a fix on the spot. Every single dessert on this menu has gone through her brain — tested, tweaked, and perfected until it's exactly right. No shortcuts, no "good enough." Only delicious.
